strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal cross-platform VPN whose logical weak-network behavior approaches UDP/QUIC while public carriers remain stock REALITY/Vision over real kernel TCP.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not add real lanes, FEC/RBC, Xray/REALITY integration or TUN until stream reassembly/dedup/FIN and datagram dedup/expiry semantics pass deterministic local tests.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed M1-001: added the pure-Go WBD v1 frame codec and protocol seed for DATA, DATAGRAM, ACK and GAP_HINT, with deterministic encoding, ACK ranges, strict bounds/malformed-input handling, and explicit separation of logical identity from transmission/lane identity.
continuation_cursor.current_task: M2-001: implement deterministic in-memory STREAM and DATAGRAM receive semantics on top of the codec; still no real lanes, FEC, Xray or TUN.
continuation_cursor.why_now: The wire vocabulary is stable enough to test the logical behavior that future multi-lane recovery depends on. Reorder, duplicate and expiry semantics must be correct before any carrier scheduler exists.
continuation_cursor.done_when: Local tests prove STREAM out-of-order buffering, contiguous delivery, duplicate suppression and FIN consistency plus DATAGRAM deduplication and hard-deadline expiry using a deterministic virtual clock, without depending on lane/TCP behavior.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: M2-001: implement an in-memory receive engine for reliable STREAM reassembly/dedup/FIN and expiring DATAGRAM delivery/dedup using a deterministic virtual clock; add adversarial reorder/duplicate/deadline tests; do not add lanes, FEC, Xray or TUN.
